title: DIRECTION v1 check_plan request
description: internal/server/direction.CheckPlanRequest (RFC 0001 section 8.3: check_plan(plan_text, actions?)). Exactly one of plan_text/actions is required at the protocol-semantics level -- the same mutual-exclusivity rule `serenity check` enforces for its own two input forms -- not expressible as a flat json-schema required list here.

items.description: internal/server/direction.CheckPlanAction -- one structured action against the closed action set.
